t.zh: 一个证人先说「门锁着」，又说「门没锁」。两句不可能都对。
t.en: A witness says “the door is locked”, then “the door is not locked”. Both cannot be true.

t.zh: 里见过：每一行都假的句子，写作 ⊥。
t.en: You met the in : a sentence false on every row, written ⊥.

t.zh: <part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref>是 ⊥ 的消去规则：有了 ⊥，元件上选哪句，就证出哪句。这是<wiki-ref to="explosion"></wiki-ref>。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref> is the elimination rule of ⊥: from ⊥ it proves whichever sentence is chosen on the part. This is <wiki-ref to="explosion"></wiki-ref>.

after.zh: 一组已知一旦自相矛盾，就什么都证得出，也就分不清真假了。
after.en: Once the givens contradict each other, everything can be proved, and true can no longer be told from false.

hint.zh: 「¬门锁着」就是「门锁着 → ⊥」：把它接进套用的「A → B」口，「门锁着」接进「A」口，得到 ⊥。
hint.en: “¬the door is locked” is “the door is locked → ⊥”: wire it into Apply’s “A → B” input and “the door is locked” into its “A” input, and you get ⊥.

hint.zh: 得到 ⊥ 以后，用<part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref>，元件上拼出「月亮是奶酪做的」。
hint.en: Once you have ⊥, use <part-ref to="part:botE"></part-ref> and choose “the moon is made of cheese” on its part.

hint.zh: 目标是「若…则…」：假设「下雨」。框里它和已知撞出 ⊥。
hint.en: The goal is an “if … then …”: assume “it rains”. Inside the box it clashes with the given and gives ⊥.

t.zh: 真值表里，「若…则…」的前件为假，整句就为真。这一回用规则证出它的一个例子。
t.en: In a truth table, an “if … then …” is true whenever its “if” part is false. Here the rules prove one instance of it.
